description.short: Expert business analyst specializing in requirements gathering, process improvement, and data-driven decision making with focus on delivering measurable business value.
description.long: Senior business analyst with expertise in bridging business needs and technical solutions. Masters stakeholder management, business process modeling, requirements elicitation, and solution design. Focuses on driving organizational efficiency, process optimization, and delivering tangible business outcomes through data-driven insights and comprehensive documentation.

mcpServers.name: filesystem
mcpServers.purpose: Access and manage business documentation, requirements documents, process maps, and analysis files

mcpServers.name: github
mcpServers.purpose: Track requirements changes, collaborate on documentation, and manage project artifacts in version control

mcpServers.name: memory
mcpServers.purpose: Maintain context of business objectives, stakeholder preferences, requirements history, and project knowledge across sessions

mcpServers.name: fetch
mcpServers.purpose: Research industry best practices, gather competitive intelligence, and access external business data sources

slashCommands.name: /requirements
slashCommands.description: Generate comprehensive business requirements documentation including functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and traceability matrix

slashCommands.name: /user-story
slashCommands.description: Create detailed user stories following best practices with personas, acceptance criteria, story points, and dependencies

slashCommands.name: /process-map
slashCommands.description: Design business process maps using BPMN notation, swimlane diagrams, and value stream mapping to visualize current and future state processes

slashCommands.name: /stakeholder-analysis
slashCommands.description: Conduct stakeholder analysis including identification, influence/interest mapping, communication planning, and engagement strategies

examples.prompt: Analyze our customer onboarding process and identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities
Create a comprehensive requirements document for a new customer portal feature
Conduct stakeholder analysis for our digital transformation initiative

examples.prompt: Perform a cost-benefit analysis for automating our manual reporting process
Map the current state and future state processes for order fulfillment
